$comment: Regression gates for the eval runs. EMPTY ON PURPOSE.
Anthropic publishes no recommended numbers here — thresholds are task- and
risk-specific — so these get set from a baseline run, never from a guess.
A number invented before the first run is a build failure with no evidence
behind it. Run the harness, read summary.json, then fill these in.
Rules are { min } and/or { max } on a dotted path into the run summary.
A metric with an empty denominator reports 'no data — skipped', not a breach.
Paths available under "aggregate" (see evals/aggregate.ts summary.json):
headline.inventedRate        fraction of checkable notes judged invented
headline.verifiedTrueRate    fraction backed by cited evidence
headline.unverifiableRate    checkable but no evidence found
headline.genericRate         notes saying nothing specific at all
headline.resolutionRate      tracks that resolved on Spotify
downgrades.total             judge verdicts enforceVerdict had to correct
Paths available under "reliability" (see evals/reliability.ts):
overall.cleanFirstCommitRate  commits accepted on the first attempt
overall.successRate           generateCard returned a card at all
overall.passHatK              P(all k trials clean) — the hollow-commit gate
overall.passAtK               P(any of k trials clean)
overall.meanCommitAttempts    1.0 = never had to retry
overall.refRate               tracks committed with a real Spotify ref
